title: Mediator's Duty to Prepare Report when No Agreement is Reached

content.scenario: After mediation, a consumer, Rohan, and a company fail to reach a settlement within the specified time. The mediator, Ms. Singh, must prepare a report and submit it to the concerned Commission.
content.outcome: The mediator, Ms. Singh, is required to prepare a report and submit it to the concerned Commission, as no agreement was reached between the parties within the specified time, as per Section 80(3) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What happens when no settlement is reached in mediation?
What is the mediator's role when no agreement is reached?
How is a report prepared and submitted when no settlement is reached?
